name: Monte Carlo Simulator
when_to_pick: Show how widely a single edge (win rate + reward-to-risk) spreads real outcomes. Renders an equity-curve fan of N (default 200) simulated runs with a 10th–90th-percentile band, a median path, and summary stats (median return, % profitable, worst drawdown, risk of ruin). A deterministic frame draws on load; Run re-rolls the seed, Reset returns to it. Use to set realistic expectations and to motivate position-sizing for the band, not the average. Pick this for the DISTRIBUTION of outcomes across many runs; for which win-rate x R:R combos are break-even use expectancy_grid; to watch a single run play out tick by tick use live_simulator_candlestick.

title.default: Monte Carlo: 200 equity paths, one edge

caption.description: Italic takeaway shown under the chart. Explain the aha in plain language.

risk_pct_default.description: Risk per trade as a percent of equity.

ruin_threshold.description: Equity-drop percent that counts as 'ruin' for the risk-of-ruin stat label.
